description.value: Finnerty Gardens is a free, publicly accessible botanical garden on the southwest edge of the University of Victoria campus, renowned for its collection of over 4,000 trees and shrubs including more than 1,500 rhododendron and azalea varieties. Open every day of the year at no charge, the gardens offer a self-guided walking tour by PDF and a tranquil setting for anyone seeking a peaceful stop on a ride through Victoria. The garden has deep historical roots tied to Lake Cowichan and is stewarded by a volunteer Friends group that funds ongoing enhancements.
